Dani Morales: Quick sync on ArborLane POC results. They asked for a concise bench writeup + recommended ask. Posting the numbers and an ops note for the deck.

Eric Liu: Ran three runs this morning with the customers traffic template. Short summary: steady 500 qps chat-gen, 2m 2.5k qps burst, embedded calls at 150 qps interleaved. Model: redwood-13B-quant (latency-optimized kernel). Node pool: 6x V100-equivalent (autoscale enabled).

Eric Liu: Aggregated latencies (tokens): chat p50 95ms, p95 220ms, p99 780ms. Embeddings p50 48ms, p95 160ms. During the 2.5k burst we saw p99 climb to ~3.6s for ~25s, correlated with autoscaler provisioning and KV cache churn when prefix cache miss rate hit ~18%. No request failures, retries <0.1%.

Eric Liu: Run config snippet: 
```
workloads:
  - name: chat_sustain
    qps: 500
    duration: 45m
  - name: high_burst
    qps: 2500
    duration: 2m
  - name: embed_mix
    qps: 150
concurrency_per_instance: 128
autoscaler:
  min_idle: 1
  scale_step: 1
  scale_cooldown_s: 30
prefix_kv_ttl_s: 600
```

Sasha Ivanova: Observations from infra: the long tails map to two things: (1) autoscale cooldown + time to attach KV cache shards when spinning new workers (~12-20s attach window), (2) transient CPU steal on node-4 during the second minute of the burst (we hit a noisy-neighbor egress window). Mitigations: set autoscaler min_idle=1 warm worker so scale up is instant, pre-populate popular prefixes before burst, and bump node CPU request to reduce OS scheduling interference. With those changes p99 at 2.5k stays below ~900ms in our retest.

Dani Morales: Great. Can we get a clear cost delta for advising 1 warm worker? Also want two pricing paths for the commercial ask: consumption and a short reserved pilot.

Nikhil Mehta: Cost notes from the test telemetry: this 45m sustained + 2m burst run consumed ~3.1 GPU-hours across the pool and ~0.6 infra-hours extra for scaling churn. Estimated per-run cost (pro-rata) ~= $1,350.

Nikhil Mehta: Suggested customer-facing pricing options: 
- Pay-as-you-go: $0.12 / 1k chat tokens, $0.018 / 1k embed tokens. For ArborLane's projection (3M tokens/day) => ~ $13.1k/mo.
- Reserved pilot (recommended): 2-month pilot, dedicated pool sized for sustained 600 qps with 2x burst headroom + 1 warm buffer. Flat $9,500 / month (includes 24/7 warm buffer and 1 free warm-day per month). Pilot includes one SLO review and an ops handoff.

Nikhil Mehta: Warm-node delta: keeping 1 warm node changes expected monthly cost by ~ +$2,200 in reserved model (capex-like monthly fee) or +$0.065 per 1k chat tokens in consumption model if they want us to bill per-warm-hour. 

Eric Liu: Technical wording to include in the customer note: 
- "Why p99 spikes happen: when the autoscaler adds instances the new workers need to fetch KV prefix shards and populate model KV caches; that attach path and warmed JIT/kernel paths cause short-lived latency increases.
- Recommended operational config: autoscaler min_idle=1, prefix_kv_ttl=600s, batch embeddings in windows of 128, and set graceful scale_cooldown_s=30 to avoid overshoot."

Sasha Ivanova: Ops attachments to include: link to the run artifacts, a one-page run playbook for their infra team (how to reproduce, which metrics to watch), and a short checklist for pre-warm before traffic ramps. ops-bot just uploaded the artifacts.

ops-bot: Artifacts available: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/poc-runs/1745056789/ (prometheus, histograms, loadgen config, attach logs).

Dani Morales: I'll draft the customer email. Draft below 1 please edit.

Dani Morales: "Hi ArborLane team 0 thanks for running the POC with us. Short bench takeaway: sustained 500 qps with p95 ~220ms, p99 ~780ms; 2.5k qps burst showed temporary p99 spikes (~3.6s) caused by autoscale + KV cache attach. We recommend enabling a 1-warm-node buffer and the prefix KV cache to keep p99 <1s under bursts. Two pricing options attached: PAYG or 2-month reserved pilot at $9,500/mo (incl. warm buffer). Artifacts and run playbook: ops link attached. — Dani (Redwood)"

Eric Liu: Edits: add the quick instruction: "we will pre-populate your top prefixes and pre-warm for 24hrs at no charge at pilot start".

Nikhil Mehta: I'll attach pricing worksheet and the legal-lite SOW. Confirmed we can do $9.5k/month for 2 months as a commercial pilot.

Sasha Ivanova: +1. Also add the dashboard link and a note about expected variance windows during cloud provider maintenance.

Dani Morales: Thanks everyone. I'll send in the next hour and paste the customer's reply back here. :rocket:
